name: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre
nameVi: Nhà hát Múa rối Thăng Long
kicker: The water-puppet theatre by the lake
summary: The theatre is at 57b Dinh Tien Hoang, on the east side of Hoan Kiem. Vietnam Tourism says the form dates from the 11th century, with puppeteers in waist-deep water and lacquered wooden figures. It also says to check the website for hours. The ticket is check on arrival.
getThere: Walk the east side of the lake
heroCaption: The Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre
gettingThere: Walk to 57b Dinh Tien Hoang, on the east side of Hoan Kiem. The minutes are check on arrival.
hours: Check on arrival. Vietnam Tourism says to check the theatre website.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. Vietnam Tourism alone says tickets start from 100,000 VND. That single figure is not the published price.
